method: Main menu background and logo screen owners, connected to clean text selection and foreground. Reused saved pinned native pseudocode; old sources still contain absolute address macros.
contracts: Background clears and draws the image only when redraw_request equals 1; panel/title/foreground always run.
Text selection precedes saving and zeroing the shared expansion control; restore happens before title draw.
Logo queries sound only if digital sound is available, before reading music enable; no sound update call occurs.
Clear helper 0x004CF1C0 and fill 0x0040F8F0 are inlined, not counted as additional migrated entries.
Logo prompt retains the explicit origin arguments required by layout-aware 0x004D6250.

verification.test_scope: Controlled C endpoints: 3 redraw cases, 8 sound cases; exact call ordering, geometry, title control restoration, pixel clear extent and guard pixels. No native differential replay.

known_limitations: Menu opening/input/host dispatch and raster/sound endpoint integration remain incomplete. Source-only tests do not prove native equivalence.
